name: io.github.guzz-labs/epwforge-mcp
description: Weather files (EPW/DDY) for any global location — search 17,000+ stations, analyze any EPW URL, render diurnal/wind-rose/temp-carpet charts, generate TMY/AMY/CMIP6-morphed/UHI/event/smoke scenarios + EnergyPlus DesignDay IDF. 3 of 4 tools work anonymously (no API key); generation tool charges credits (5 welcome credits free at signup).

environmentVariables.description: EPWForge API key — only required for generate_weather_file. Find/analyze/chart tools work without it. Generate a free key (any tier) at https://epwforge.com/account.
environmentVariables.name: EPWFORGE_API_KEY

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional — only required for generate_weather_file. Other tools (find_station, analyze_weather, chart_weather) work anonymously. Bearer EPWForge API key (sk_live_...) from https://epwforge.com/account, OR OAuth via the 'Add to Claude' flow.
